testcase.name: every change is saved, and a no-op removal is not
a word is learned on its second commit, not its first
URL, email and no-suggestions fields do learn
minus word on a half-learned word clears its count
an unknown format version or an empty store starts empty rather than guessing
the file is versioned and human-readable
a dictionary word is never learned, and neither is a non-word token
commits in a password field never count
minus word forgets it, and it needs two fresh commits to come back
learned words and pending counts survive a reload
